description: Weighted comparator — it multiplies three inputs by three weights, adds them up, and sends 10V when the total reaches the threshold

params.text: Sets the weight its own input is multiplied by, -5 to +5, and the reading beside it shows the value
Sets the level the weighted total has to reach for the output to go high, -10V to +10V

inputs.text: One of the three signals being weighted and added
Volts here are added to that row's weight, and the sum is held between -5 and +5
Volts here are added to the threshold, and the sum is held between -10V and +10V

outputs.text: 10V while the weighted total is at or above the threshold, and 0V below it
